name: Kuro wa Kyou mo Orusuban!
original_name: クロは今日もおるすばん！
source:
Kuro loves the owner, Aoi-kun. Boasting a smooth and fluffy coat, he likes the red collar.

Wake up your husband who has a bad sleep today, and stay at home with a good boy!

"Aoi-kun, can't you come back soon?"

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21975]Freem![/url]]
translation:
黑喜欢店主葵君。他拥有光滑蓬松的外套，喜欢红色领子。

叫醒今天睡不好的老公，乖乖待在家里吧！

“葵君，你就不能快点回来吗？”

[摘自 [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21975]Freem![/url]]
